verdict.rationale: Moss documents official Python and TypeScript/JavaScript (Node) SDKs, plus Swift, Elixir, C and a WASM build. No evidence shows Go or Java SDKs, so only half of the named major languages are covered. Missing for 10: official Go SDK, official Java SDK, independent corroboration of SDK maturity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against official SDKs in the major languages (Python, TypeScript, Go, Java)

citations.quote: Install the Python or TypeScript SDK and run your first semantic search in minutes.
One model across every surface: JavaScript (Node), Python, Swift (iOS), Elixir, C, and an in-browser/WASM build.
The Node (`@moss-js/moss`) and Python SDKs can cache the downloaded index to disk
